workItem: Fix the existing PR Decision Evidence Reconciler so an active provider auto-merge can be safely disarmed before stale PR-body evidence is repaired.
workItemDE: Den bestehenden PR Decision Evidence Reconciler so korrigieren, dass aktives Provider-Auto-Merge vor der Reparatur veralteter PR-Body-Evidence sicher deaktiviert werden kann.
priorityReason: PR #1381 proved that stale governance evidence remains unrepaired when the leading writer cannot disable an already-active GitHub auto-merge request.
dependencies: existing PR Decision Evidence Reconciler single-writer chain
PR #1381 run 35958041567 / job 107500472507 observed failure evidence
scopeBoundary: No second PR-body writer, autofix controller, merge authority or workflow architecture.
No weakening of fail-closed auto-merge safety: body mutation remains blocked until an active provider auto-merge request is disarmed.
Permission expansion is limited to the existing reconcile job that already owns PR-body and auto-merge provider mutation.
Candidate code remains data-only and is never executed with write credentials.
No direct main mutation and no autonomous merge.
exitEvidence: Reconcile job grants contents:write together with pull-requests:write for GitHub GraphQL auto-merge mutation.
Regression test binds the permission to the existing disablePullRequestAutoMerge safety path.
Workflow/security validation and exact-head CI pass.
PR #1381 can subsequently converge stale production-baseline evidence without Resource not accessible by integration.
acceptanceCriteria: When livePr.auto_merge is active and the PR is HUMAN_MERGE_REQUIRED, provider auto-merge is disabled before any body PATCH.
If provider disarm still fails, the reconciler remains fail-closed and does not rewrite merge-safety evidence.
After successful disarm, stale production baseline and Decision/Evidence may converge in the same leading writer generation.
No compatibility relay receives PR-body write authority.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
